title: GA4GH IO Profile Meta-Schema
description: Meta-schema for validating GA4GH workflow and tool IO JSON Schema profiles. The top level requires the inputs/outputs wrapper and may carry the top-level keywords of the workflow vocabulary; every schema, at any depth, must follow the rules of $defs/node, which combines one vocabulary file per keyword group.

allOf.$comment: The keywords of every schema plus the top-level keywords; other x-ga4gh-* keywords are rejected. The check of unevaluated keywords sits in this branch, next to the rules that reach nested schemas, so that it doesn't evaluate the nested schemas a second time (see $defs/node).

$schema.description: IO schemas must name this meta-schema.

$id.description: The identifier of the IO schema: an absolute URI that is stable and versioned, never the URL of a branch.

not.description: URLs of branches at GitHub and GitLab: refs/heads/ or a common branch name (main, master, dev, develop, HEAD) in place of a tag or commit. A best-effort check: it is case-sensitive and doesn't know other branch names.

inputs.description: JSON Schema block defining the expected input parameters for the workflow or tool.

outputs.description: JSON Schema block defining the outputs of the workflow or tool: an object schema whose properties are the outputs. Optional; without it, the schema describes no outputs.
outputs.$comment: The outputs are the direct properties of this schema, so that normalisers find them without resolving references or applicators.

$comment: The top level takes the rules of every schema from $defs/node ($defs/schema and $defs/keywords, without its check of unevaluated keywords), adds the top-level keywords, and rejects other x-ga4gh-* keywords itself. Nested schemas get all of $defs/node, so top-level keywords are rejected there.

node.title: GA4GH IO Profile Schema Rules
node.description: Applies to every schema of an IO schema, at any depth: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 plus the x-ga4gh-* keywords of the vocabularies. Keywords starting with x-ga4gh- that no vocabulary defines are rejected.
node.$comment: Two branches: the rules that reach nested schemas ($defs/subschemas) and the check of the x-ga4gh-* keywords. The check of unevaluated keywords sees only the vocabularies: validators that evaluate what such a check sees once more, to collect annotations, would otherwise validate every nested schema again at each level, in time exponential in the depth of nesting. The Draft 2020-12 meta-schema is not applied here but once per tree ($defs/schema), because it checks the whole tree below the schema it is applied to.

allOf.$comment: Every keyword that doesn't start with x-ga4gh- counts as evaluated; the vocabularies evaluate the x-ga4gh-* keywords they define; any other x-ga4gh-* keyword is unevaluated and rejected. The pattern is in an allOf that always passes, so that its annotations survive when $defs/keywords fails (otherwise validators that report all errors flag every standard keyword as unevaluated), and Ajv handles it with allErrors.

schema.title: GA4GH IO Profile Schema Tree
schema.description: The rules of a tree of schemas without its x-ga4gh-* keywords: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 for the schema and, through its applicators, every schema nested in it, and $defs/node for every subschema ($defs/subschemas). Applied to the top level and to each x-ga4gh-tabular-schema, which Draft 2020-12 doesn't reach.

keywords.title: GA4GH IO Profile Keywords
keywords.description: The x-ga4gh-* keywords of every schema, one vocabulary file per keyword group. None of them applies $defs/node to a nested schema ($defs/subschemas does). Used by $defs/node and, without the check of unevaluated keywords, by the top level.

subschemas.title: GA4GH IO Profile Subschemas
subschemas.description: Applies $defs/node to every subschema: the values of the applicators of JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, of the deprecated definitions and dependencies (which the Draft 2020-12 meta-schema also checks), and of x-ga4gh-tabular-schema.
subschemas.$comment: Explicit $refs instead of the $dynamicRef of the Draft 2020-12 meta-schema: some validators (e.g., Ajv) support $dynamicAnchor only at the root of a schema and would skip these rules. The Draft 2020-12 meta-schema ($defs/schema) still checks every subschema against plain JSON Schema. A new applicator of JSON Schema, or a new x-ga4gh-* keyword whose value is a schema, needs an entry here.

x-ga4gh-tabular-schema.$comment: A new tree: Draft 2020-12 doesn't reach it.
